name: Liverpool John Moores University
description:
Liverpool John Moores University is located in the northern dock city of Liverpool, England.

The university was first established in 1823 as the Liverpool Mechanics' School of Art. Today, it is the 35th largest university in the UK.

It is highly ranked for teaching and research in Sports and Exercise Sciences. The university also ranks 70th in the Guardian's University Guide 2021.

What is the Liverpool John Moores University acceptance rate for International Students?

The Liverpool John Moores University acceptance rate is 70%.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Liverpool John Moores University (LJMU) is a public research university in the vibrant city of Liverpool, England. When you choose LJMU, you’ll be in one of the most consistently ranked universities in the UK. If research is your thing, you’ll find that over 97% of its research has been rated internationally excellent or world-leading (REF 2021).

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: You’ll be joining a diverse, welcoming community of more than 25,000 students from over 100 countries. Plus, LJMU offers a wide array of clubs and societies. Whether you're passionate about sports, arts, culture, or academics, there's a group for you. Moreover, the Student Advice and Wellbeing (SAW) team offers a range of services to support your mental and physical health.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
You'll be pleased to know that the university offers a variety of student accommodation options, all situated in the heart of Liverpool. LJMU partners with several trusted private providers to offer a range of accommodation types for different preferences and budgets. Depending on the accommodation you choose, you can expect various amenities, such as laundry facilities, gyms, study areas​, and more.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Avril Robarts Library serves as the primary library. It offers you a wide range of books, journals, and digital resources. The library also has quiet study areas, group workspaces, and individual study pods. What’s more is that you can grab a coffee or snack from the library’s cafe.

Sports
You’ll find that LJMU has state-of-the-art sports facilities managed by the Sport and Physical Activity Department. These include an eight-court sports hall, two multifunctional studio rooms, a two-floor gym, and many more facilities.

Laboratory
As a student at LMJU, you’ll have access to several specialised laboratories across various disciplines. Some of these include the School of Pharmacy and Biomolecular Sciences, and the Electrical and Electronic Engineering Research Centre.

Cafeteria
Besides great classrooms, you’ll also see that LJMU's campuses have a variety of cafes and eateries. The Pavilion Cafe at the Aldham Robarts Library is a convenient spot for you to relax or study. You can also explore the Student Life Building Cafe or the Green Room.
